newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends light session touch lower.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends light session touch lower.

text.p: White sugar futures closed slightly lower on Monday after an uninspiring session where volume was light and trading ranges tight.
London's spot May contract spurned later bullish sentiment in New York and was content to meander in a tight $2.00 range.
Some light activity was reported on the nearby May/May arbitrage but interest was still generally thin.
The May and August contrtacts both closed 40 cents lower, at $307.00 and $305.70 respectively. Volume amounted to 811 lots, boosted by a last-minute flurry of trading.
Market sources have said London will either need a dose of fresh fundamental news to break out of its recent lethargy or New York's May contract to move away from its stifling ranges.
